note: `minecraft:connection` block trait exposes connection states (e.g. `minecraft:cardinal_connections`) that update when neighboring blocks change. Used by blocks that visually connect like fences or glass panes.
note2: Available without the Upcoming Creator Features experimental toggle in 1.26.0.

generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Block Connection
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

fields.title: Enabled States
fields.description: Which connection states to enable. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_connections"]. Must specify at least one.
